metadata.methods_description: EEG recordings were conducted during two conditions: 3-minute eyes-open resting state and task-specific activities (reading aloud with comprehension questions for the reading group; two blocks of 20 arithmetic operations for the math group). Psychometric evaluations included spelling tests (orthographic and phonological errors), reading speed (words per minute), reading comprehension (multiple-choice), mathematical knowledge assessment, selective attention testing, and IQ measurement. Participants were randomly assigned to experimental (3-month Smartick intervention) or control groups, with assessments conducted at baseline (PRE-intervention, ses-1) and follow-up (POST-intervention, ses-2).
